body: Meera, JIDA Oct 2026 p.14 mein ek finding hai — 3-month fluoride recall se high-risk adults mein caries recurrence 38% kam hua vs 6-month. Since you have a high-risk adult cohort, I've drafted a WhatsApp message you can send to remind them. Just say go and I'll send it.
rationale: Specificity lever: 38% caries reduction, JIDA citation. Effort externalization: drafted WhatsApp message for immediate use.

body: Meera ji, DCI circular 2026-11-04 says radiograph dose limits are changing. Maximum dose per IOPA exposure is dropping to 1.0 mSv by Dec 15. E-speed film is okay, D-speed nahi. I've drafted a quick SOP update you can share with your staff to ensure compliance. Want me to send it over?
rationale: Effort externalization: SOP update drafted for immediate use. Specificity: DCI circular date and new dose limit cited.

body: Hi Priya 🦷 Dr. Meera's clinic se — aapki 6-month cleaning recall due hai, last visit May 12th ko tha. Aapke liye 2 slots ready hain: Wed 5 Nov 6pm ya Thu 6 Nov 5pm. ₹299 cleaning + complimentary fluoride. Reply 1 for Wed, 2 for Thu.
rationale: Effort externalization: slots pre-selected matching her weekday-evening preference. Specificity: date, price, freebie named.

body: Bharat ji, aapke calls -50% down hain in the last 7 days. But don't worry, aapke locality mein, Andheri West mein, 3 aur dentists ne same trend dekha hai. Maybe try offering 'Free Smile Analysis + Digital Scan'? It usually boosts engagement. Want me to set that up for you?
rationale: Social proof: 3 peers in Andheri West saw the same trend. Specificity: -50% calls in 7 days.

body: Bharat, aapka Pro plan 12 din mein expire ho raha hai. Just FYI, Andheri West mein active dentists on magicpin are getting 2,500 views and 15 calls per month. You're currently at 980 views and 4 calls. Don't lose out on potential patients. Want to renew your Pro plan for ₹4999?
rationale: Loss aversion: highlighted potential loss of views and calls if plan expires. Peer anchor: compared merchant's performance to active dentists in the same locality.

body: Lakshmi, Diwali is coming up on Oct 31st. Smart salon owners start pushing packages 2-3 months out. Since Kapra mein bridal makeup artist searches +31% are already up YoY, focus on Bridal Trial @ ₹999 now. It's a high-intent service to upsell from. Want me to draft a WhatsApp campaign for your lapsed customers?
rationale: Social proof: bridal makeup artist searches are up 31% YoY. Specificity: Diwali date and Bridal Trial price mentioned.

body: Hi Kavya, Lakshmi here from Studio11 Family Salon. Since your bridal trial on March 22nd, I've put together a 30-day skin prep program for you, keeping your wedding date of Nov 8th in mind. It includes a series of hair spas and facials to make sure you look your best. Shall I send you the details?
rationale: Effort externalization: 30-day skin prep program already prepared. Specificity: Anchored on trial date and wedding date.

body: Hi Lakshmi, Studio11 is doing great — aapke views +14% up hain last week. To keep the momentum going, what's the most requested service this week? I'll draft a quick Google post for you based on your answer.
rationale: Asking the merchant: what's the most-asked service this week? Anchor: views +14% up last week.

body: Anjali, since your Pro subscription expired 38 days ago, 24 new lapsed customers add ho gaye hain. Your CTR is down -45% vs other Aundh salons (0.022 vs 0.040). I've drafted a 'Haircut @ ₹99' offer to win them back. Want me to launch it?
rationale: Curiosity lever: specific data about lapsed customers and CTR dip since expiry. Effort externalization: offer already drafted.

body: Suresh, DC vs MI match toh hai aaj. Since it's a weekend, expect fewer covers than weekdays. Smart move: run 'Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free' offer only for delivery tonight. 3 other restaurants in Sant Nagar are doing the same. Want me to set up the delivery banner for you?
rationale: Contrarian operator insight: Weekend IPL hurts dine-in. Social proof: 3 peers in Sant Nagar are doing the same.

body: Suresh, SK Pizza Junction ke reviews mein 'delivery late' ka theme rising hai — 4 mentions in the last 30 days. Ek customer ne likha 'took 50 mins for a 15 min ride'. This is free market research, use it! Want me to draft a response template + ek Google Business Profile post addressing this?
rationale: Specificity lever: '4 mentions in the last 30 days' and a direct quote from a customer review. Effort externalization: draft response template and GBP post.

body: Suresh, you're almost at 150 reviews! Congrats. Since your CTR is already 28% higher than other Indiranagar restaurants, I've drafted a Google post announcing the milestone. Also, a WhatsApp broadcast to your customers about your Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149. Ready to post?
rationale: Social proof lever: approaching review milestone. Specificity: CTR is 28% higher than peers.

body: Suresh, since your weekday thali is doing well (18 orders/day), let's create a corporate version. Most Indiranagar offices are back 4 days/week. We can offer a 'Corporate Lunch Thali' for ₹129 in bulk orders (min 10). This can increase your weekday footfall. Want me to draft a quick proposal with pricing tiers?
rationale: Anchored on the existing weekday thali success (18 orders/day) and leveraged the corporate bulk thali package intent. Effort externalization: offer to draft a proposal.

body: Karthik, views are down 30% this week. But chill, April-June is always slow for gyms. Smart move: focus on PT sessions with your existing members. 'Personal trainer cost' searches are up 38% yoy among 30-50 year olds in Bangalore. Want me to draft a promo for 'Personal Training Demo @ ₹199'?
rationale: Operator insight: seasonal dip is normal, reframes as opportunity. Specificity: 'Personal trainer cost' searches are up 38% yoy.

body: Hi Rashmi, PowerHouse Fitness here! We noticed it's been almost 2 months since your last visit on Feb 28th. We know you were focused on weight loss during your 5-month membership. We've got a Personal Training Demo @ ₹199 tailored to get you back on track. Ready to book a session?
rationale: Specificity lever: Anchored on Rashmi's last visit date and previous focus on weight loss. Offer: Personal Training Demo @ ₹199 is relevant to her past goals.

body: Padma, since you're planning a kids yoga summer camp, note that 'yoga classes near me' searches are up 42% YoY, especially among women aged 25-55. Smart move to tap into this demand. Instead of generic classes, how about a 4-week 'Yoga for Focus' program targeting school kids? Want me to draft a quick outline?
rationale: Specificity lever: 42% YoY increase in yoga class searches. Merchant fit: Directly addresses her intent to add a kids yoga program.

body: Hi Sumitra, Zen Yoga Studio here. Karthik Jr. attended the kids yoga trial on Apr 22. Since then, our 'kids yoga' program page views are up 10%. We've got a Saturday morning slot for him: Sat 3 May, 8am. ₹499 for the first month. Want to book it for Karthik?
rationale: Anchored on the 10% increase in program page views since the trial. Specificity: date of trial, date of next session, price.

body: Ramesh, since you're compliance-aware, quick update: atorvastatin batches AT2024-1102 and AT2024-1108 from MfrZ have a voluntary recall. Since your calls are already 18% higher than other pharmacies in Malviya Nagar, I've drafted a WhatsApp to your customers about generic alternatives. Want me to send it?
rationale: Effort externalization: drafted customer message about alternatives. Social proof: anchored on above-peer calls to highlight potential impact.

body: Namaste Ramesh! Mr. Sharma ki medicines khatam hone wali hain. Unka last refill 26th March ko hua tha aur metformin, atorvastatin, telmisartan ki stock 28th April tak chalegi. Unka saved delivery address bhi available hai. Should I send him a quick reminder on WhatsApp about refilling?
rationale: Effort externalization: Ready to send a refill reminder. Specificity: Last refill date and medicine names mentioned.

body: Ramesh, summer mein normally cough/cold medicines toh slow ho jaate hain (-60% demand). But ORS, sunscreen, anti-fungal mein +38-45% spike hai. Since your CTR is already 0.045 vs peer avg 0.038, focus on shelf placement for these summer essentials. Want me to draft a quick 'summer essentials' promo for your WhatsApp?
rationale: Contrarian insight: cough/cold down, summer essentials up. Specificity: CTR vs peer, seasonal demand percentages.

body: Vikas, your Google Business Profile isn't verified yet. Aaj kal, unverified listings AI search results mein neeche dikhte hain. Verified profiles get around 30% more visibility. I can draft the verification request for you – it's a simple postcard or phone call.
rationale: Loss aversion: unverified GBP leads to less visibility in AI search. Specificity: 30% uplift, postcard/phone call verification.

body: Meera, Lajpat Nagar ke 3 aur dentists ne IDA ka upcoming webinar register kiya hai. It's free for members like you, and a good way to network. I've already filled out the form with your details — just need your confirmation to submit. Want me to register you?
rationale: Social proof lever: 3 dentists in Lajpat Nagar already registered. Effort externalization: Form pre-filled, ready to submit.

body: Meera, Smile Studio just 1.3km away opened on April 8th and they're pushing 'Dental Cleaning @ ₹199'. Smart move by them. Your Dental Cleaning @ ₹299 is converting at avg_ctr 0.021, while peer median is 0.030. Maybe time to refresh your offer? Want to see their listing and what they're offering?
rationale: Voyeur curiosity lever: new competitor nearby. Specificity: competitor name, distance, offer, and opening date.

body: Padma, your calls are up 15% this week. Good job on the kids yoga post — that's driving the spike. Since you're active planning, consider this: 'yoga classes near me' searches are up 42% YoY among 25-55 year old females. Should we target them with a 'Couple/Family Plan @ ₹999/month' offer?
rationale: Social proof: 15% call increase this week. Specificity: 42% YoY increase in yoga class searches among females 25-55.

body: Hi Anjali, Glamour Lounge ke views pichle hafte 12% down hain. I know subscription expired, but Aundh mein 3 salons ne phir bhi winback offers run kiye. I've drafted a 'Haircut @ ₹99' offer for your lapsed customers. Just say go and I'll send it out?
rationale: Loss aversion: views are down, winback opportunity. Social proof: 3 salons in Aundh ran winback offers.
